player_prompt.intro:
I nih hi Player {player_id} ni, Reverse Tic Tac Toe khelna i ni. I symbol hi '{symbol}' a ni.
Thil tum leh tur a ni - a then (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) pathum in a lo awm lo.
Pathum in a awm a, i chak lo ang.
I move i pe turin format '[4]' hi hmang rawh, cell 4-ah i symbol i pe thei ang.
Player {player_id} i nih a, '{symbol}' i ni a, i opponent chu '{opponent_symbol}' a ni.

invalid_move.invalid_cell: Cell index dik lo a ni.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} an symbol ({symbol}) cell {cell}-ah a pe.

outcome.loss: Player {player_id} chuan line khat a zawh veleh an hloh!
outcome.draw: A inhnehtawk a ni! Tu mah an hloh lo.
